outcome: concentrations of organic and inorganic toxins in serum or whole blood
cohort: Pregnant or delivering women in two regions of Argentina (Ushuaia and Salta)
finding: The study highlights the socioeconomic differences between Ushuaia and Salta and emphasizes the need for comprehensive assessment of environmental exposures in the Southern Hemisphere.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were more common in Ushuaia, with 43% of deliveries compared to only 6% in Salta.
